newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: PROGRESSIVE Q4 SAME STORE SALES DIP 2.8 PCT.
newsitem.headline: PROGRESSIVE Q4 SAME STORE SALES DIP 2.8 PCT.

text.p: One of New Zealand's largest supermarket operators Progressive Enterprises Ltd said on Wednesday its same store sales for the fourth quarter of its financial year fell by 2.8 percent.
That gave an annual equivalent fall of 1.3 percent, "with all divisions performing in line with expectations".
Progressive said total group sales for the fifty-three week financial reporting period ended August 3 were NZ$2.14 billion.
Total fourth quarter group sales, normalised to thirteen weeks, were $508.7 million, a decrease of 2.8 percent on the thirteen week fourth quarter of last year.
Year to date sales (normalised to 52 weeks) of $2.1 billion were 2.1 percent below the 52-week prior year.
Overall total supermarket sales for the financial year, normalised to 52 weeks were 0.8 percent below the prior year, it added.
